Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 5
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogical relationship. Despite WebSurfer correctly finding that John II’s father was Jacob I and that Jacob I’s father was Bernard I, the Planner incorrectly jumped to Jacob I’s grandfather (Rudolf VII) and presented him as John II’s paternal grandfather. This generation slip led to the wrong final answer.
